No large fleshy galls (ruling out Common smut). Some kernels appear tan/brown with white mold patches.

**Key comparisons:**
- **Fusarium** reference: White cottony mold on scattered kernels — matches the test image pattern very well
- **Diplodia**: White mold but starts from the base with bleached husks — doesn't match the scattered pattern
- **Aspergillus**: Olive-green powdery mold — wrong color
- **Trichoderma**: Dark green mold — wrong color
- **Gibberella**: Pink-red mold at tip — wrong color and location

The scattered white to grayish cottony mold on individual kernels across the ear, with tan/brown discolored kernels, is the hallmark of Fusarium ear rot.
